verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird publishes named AI-powered tools beyond marketing talk: SCC Generator, German Term Sheet Generator, Contract Express-based automation, a Legora collaboration for a Generative AI legal assistant, Evaluate (bid analysis automation), and Luminance-based document review — each with concrete descriptions of how they work. Missing for 10: detailed internal AI governance/ethics policies, technical specifics on model usage/data handling, and independent/hands-on corroboration of these tools' performance.
